correctness.rationale: Exact Gramian factorization yields tr=1+q^d and det=q^d sin^2(dπ/4); strict monotonicity within two angular classes eliminates every lag except one or two, analytically for all integers. Initial-time shift invariance is treated separately for the condition number. Standard-library verification checks polynomial identities and 6970 supplementary finite cases; finite cases are not used as proof.

value.rationale: The fixed two-read observation budget and one scalar sensor produce a natural, complete, nontrivial choice between adjacent and orthogonal-direction readings under damping. Four different exact, strictly ordered crossovers show why E, A, D and K optimize different schedules even on the same simple physical model. Infinite-lag exclusion and exact ties distinguish a global phase diagram from a numerical example; the result supplies concrete criterion-aware scheduling choices but claims no general oscillator optimality.
